mapper.select: select gm.*, m.nick_name, m.avatar_url from mall_group_member gm left join mall_member m on m.member_id = gm.member_id where gm.group_order_id = #{groupOrderId} order by gm.joined_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_group_member(group_order_id, member_id, quantity, address_id, joined_time) values(#{groupOrderId}, #{memberId}, #{quantity}, #{addressId}, #{joinedTime})
mapper.update: update mall_group_member set order_id = #{orderId} where id = #{id}
